# i-lawsuit.com

> > i-lawsuit.com connects individuals harmed by defective medical devices and pharmaceutical products with legal representation for product liability and personal injury claims.

i-lawsuit.com specializes in mass tort litigation and class action lawsuits, particularly for dangerous medical devices like Paragard IUD and IVC filters, as well as pharmaceutical products linked to cancer. The site provides legal guidance on statute of limitations, medical malpractice claims, and personal injury recovery across multiple jurisdictions.
